lead.description: a change in behaviour that comes from being studied rather than from the condition under test

self_checks.title: First-year peak
self_checks.prompt: A baseline of 100 units rises by 10 percent. What is the new level?

self_checks.title: Plant-wide gap
self_checks.prompt: On a baseline of 100, a 10 percent peak is 110 and a 1.4 percent rise is 101.4. What is the gap?

self_checks.title: Later peak
self_checks.prompt: A later peak is 20 percent above a baseline of 100, and the earlier peak was 110. How many units above 110 is the later peak?
self_checks.answer: The later peak is 120, which is 10 units above 110.

mccambridge2014.title: Systematic review of the Hawthorne effect: new concepts are needed to study research participation effects

overview_sentence: A [Hawthorne effect](articles/hawthorne-effect.qmd) is a change in behaviour that comes from being studied.
